scripts.build: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @workhorse/demo build
scripts.demo:app: pnpm db:reset:demo && pnpm build:runtime:dev && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.demo:production: pnpm build && WORKHORSE_DEMO_MODE=production tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.signoz:up: foundryctl cast --file ops/signoz/casting.yaml --pours ops/signoz/pours && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts add && pnpm signoz:dashboards
scripts.signoz:down: docker compose -f ops/signoz/pours/deployment/compose.yaml down && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts remove
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @workhorse/core typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && pnpm -r --filter './typescript/*' --filter '!@workhorse/core' --if-present typecheck && pnpm --dir dashboard/app typecheck && pnpm docs:typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:build-check && pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:prepare: tsx scripts/with-env.ts pnpm --filter @workhorse/prisma exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:database: pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:database:changed: pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:schema: pnpm schema:check && pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run typescript/core/test/schema-limits.test.ts typescript/core/test/schema-installation.test.ts typescript/core/test/schema-migrations.test.ts
scripts.test:protocol: pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts typescript/core/test/sql-protocol-conformance.test.ts typescript/core/test/schema-migrations.test.ts
scripts.test:changed: pnpm test:prepare && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:site-smoke: pnpm docs:build && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx typescript/core/test/site-smoke.ts
scripts.example:agentic-flow: pnpm build:runtime && tsx scripts/with-env.ts node typescript/examples/agentic-flow.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --import-plugin --vitest-plugin --ignore-pattern site/next-env.d.ts typescript dashboard site scripts vitest*.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --import-plugin --vitest-plugin --ignore-pattern site/next-env.d.ts typescript dashboard site scripts vitest*.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:packed && pnpm test:site-smoke && pnpm test:demo-smoke
scripts.db:reset:all: pnpm db:reset:dev && pnpm db:reset:test && pnpm db:reset:bench && pnpm db:reset:demo
